verdict.rationale: Factory surfaces AI-generated insights and suggestions directly from a user's codebase/data: Droid analyzes PRs and posts inline AI-powered review comments, the /review command gives 'AI-powered insights' on code changes, and /readiness-report evaluates and even auto-fixes repository readiness issues. These are all first-party doc claims with no independent hands-on corroboration. Missing for 10: independent/user validation of insight quality, and evidence of insights beyond code/repo data (e.g., broader business data).
